prompt: Simulate turbulent flow in a 3D circular pipe with a diameter of 0.04 meters and a length of 0.4 meters. The fluid is air with a kinematic viscosity of \(1.5 \times 10^{-5} \, \text{m}^2/\text{s}\) and a density of \(1.225 \, \text{kg}/\text{m}^3\). The Reynolds number is given as 30,000. The flow is turbulent. The simulation is steady-state. The turbulence model to be used is kOmegaSST. The inlet velocity magnitude is calculated to be \(1.5 \, \text{m/s}\) to achieve the specified Reynolds number. The domain is 3D.
